title: Constant positive density puts the support inside the carrier up to an Hⁿ-null set
statement: For all P, n, k ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), every integer multiplicity triple R = (S, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n representing T, every p ∈ ℝ^P and every ρ ∈ ℝ with B_ρ(p) ⊆ U: if k ≥ 1 and Θⁿ(μ_T, y) = k (HasMassDensity T y k) for every y ∈ spt T ∩ B_ρ(p), then Hⁿ((spt T ∩ B_ρ(p)) ∖ S) = 0, where Hⁿ := μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (p : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ball p ρ ⊆ U → 1 ≤ k → (∀ y ∈ T.support, y ∈ ball p ρ → HasMassDensity T y k) → μHE[n] ((T.support ∩ ball p ρ) \ R.carrier) = 0
